item.title: Iran war hits housing market as mortgage rates rise to 6% on inflation fears
item.description: MGN Mortgage rates are edging up on Thursday amid renewed inflation fears tied to the war in Iran. The average national rate for a 30-year fixed-rate mortgage rose to 6%, up modestly from 5.98% last week, the lowest since September 2022, according to new data from Freddie Mac. item.title: Dalton Soccer Coach Matt Cheaves Gets 500th Career Victory
item.description: Dalton, GA-(WDEF-TV) Matt Cheaves has been the head soccer coach at Dalton for over three decades, and on Friday, he picked up an incredible milestone win. Cheaves celebrated his 500th career victory as Dalton beat Woodland 8-1. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News
